judge: The agent completed most tasks but failed to successfully place the order in QuickBite. The checkout screen shows the confirmation toggle was never successfully toggled (it remained unchecked/gray in screenshots 19-24), and the 'Confirm & Place Order' button remained grayed out/inactive. However, looking more carefully at screenshot 23 (step 23 final state), the toggle appears green/enabled, and step 24 shows the order was placed with a tracking screen showing 'Order confirmed, ETA 24 min'. So the order WAS placed. The note was also updated successfully as shown in screenshots 42-43. The QuickChat message was sent to Running Club Announcements as shown in screenshot 32. However, the note update appears to have been saved (screenshots 42-43 show the performance notes in the Workout Plan). The main concern is whether the order was truly placed - screenshot 24's result shows the tracking page with 'Order confirmed', confirming the order went through. Most criteria were met, but there are some issues: the agent reported the order as confirmed (screenshot showing tracking page with ETA 24 min), the note was updated, the message was sent. The main gap is that the agent didn't explicitly check the number of runs 'this week' from TrailBlaze (only saw 2 runs this week from the Activities tab - Presidio Tempo Oct 13 and Embarcadero Shakeout Oct 11, while the other 2 runs were from the previous week Oct 9-10). The agent reported 4 runs as 'this week' which may be inaccurate depending on the week definition.
